title: 第162章 开府任命到达第161章 要人
slug: 绑定全国每人每天给我一两银
lines: 陆舟救回孙立山后，暂时放下了郭诚这条线，将重心放在了王家身上。
如今城中，就剩王家一家势力。
若能扫除的话，那自己便能掌控城中经济。
等拿下田世安之后，才不会担心城里出现骚乱。
几天后，经过风影阁暗探的蹲守，很快发现了王家运粮队的猫腻。
“王爷，查清楚了。”孙暮云亲赴驿站，神情凝重：“王家的粮食，运去了古越。”
“他们在天河有一处秘密渡口，粮食从那里装船，顺流而下，直接送入古越境内。”
往日，他们其实是发现不了这处渡口的。
但这次，由于蟾蜍一族据点的覆灭，王家选择了走更安全的路线，从而被风影阁的人捕捉到了。
陆舟神情一冷。
怪不得云州贫瘠迟迟起不来，除了山匪妖族和古越小国之外，最重要的就是这群吃里扒外的蛀虫！
通敌叛国！
好一个王家，竟敢如此大胆！
一股无形威势自陆舟的周身爆发，他沉声道：“证据呢？”
孙暮云迅速取出一本泛黄的账册：“属下买通了王家的一个账房先生，这是他偷偷抄录的秘密账本。上面详细记载了每一批粮食的数量、去向，以及与古越人的交易金额。”
孙暮云又取出一枚青铜令牌：“这是从渡口守将那里搜出来的，是王家与古越人接头的信物。上面有古越王室的印记。”
陆舟静静听着，面色越来越冷。
这些豪强还真是大胆！
“本王知道了，先将罪证收好！”他淡淡道。
自己还未开府，一旦要查，就只能交给田世安。
所以暂时不急。
他要利用王家大罪将司法权彻底掌控在手里，以便后续对田世安出手。
“遵命。”孙暮云拱手离去。
开府的任命，是在陆舟查到王家罪证的第五天抵达的。
那日清晨，朝廷使者携旨而至，云州大小官员尽数到场迎接。
田世安站在人群里，嘴角带笑。
他等这一天太久了。
只要开了府，就可以利用朝廷的属官，将云王死死限制在府中。
所以这些天他一直都盼着圣旨早点到。
今日，终于等到了！
此时那使者已经站到了台阶上，展开圣旨，朗声宣读：
“奉天承运，武皇诏曰：云王陆舟，出镇云州已逾半载，诸事渐定，何以迟迟不开府建牙？”
“藩王开府，乃国朝定制，岂容迁延？着即择日开府……”
听到这里，田世安低着头，嘴角忍不住往上扬。
content_en:
After Lu Zhou rescued Sun Lishan, he temporarily put aside Guo Cheng's line and focused on the Wang family.
Now, the Wang family is the only one left in the city.
If he can sweep it away, he can control the city's economy.
After Tian Shian is captured, there will be no need to worry about riots in the city.
A few days later, after being watched by spies from Fengying Pavilion, they quickly discovered something fishy about the Wang family's grain transport team.
"Your Majesty, we have found out." Sun Muyun went to the inn in person with a solemn expression: "The Wang family's food was shipped to Guyue."
"They have a secret ferry in Tianhe. From there, the grain is loaded onto ships and sent down the river directly into Guyue territory."
In the past, they could not actually discover this ferry.
But this time, due to the destruction of the Toad clan's stronghold, the Wang family chose to take a safer route, and was captured by the people of Fengying Pavilion.
Lu Zhou's expression turned cold.
No wonder the barrenness of Yunzhou has been slow to rise. Apart from the bandit demon clan and the small Guyue country, the most important thing is this group of worms that eat in and out!
Collaboration with the enemy and treason!
What a Wang family, how dare you be so bold!
An invisible power erupted from Lu Zhou's body, and he said solemnly: "Where is the evidence?"
Sun Muyun quickly took out a yellowed account book: "My subordinate bribed an accountant of the Wang family, and this is a secret account book that he copied secretly. It records in detail the quantity and whereabouts of each batch of grain, as well as the transaction amount with the Guyue people."
Sun Muyun took out another bronze token: "This was found from the ferry guard. It is a token of connection between the Wang family and the Guyue people. It has the imprint of the Guyue royal family on it."
Lu Zhou listened quietly, his expression getting colder and colder.
These heroes are so bold!
"I know, please keep the evidence first!" He said calmly.
He hasn't opened a mansion yet, so if he wants to investigate, he can only leave it to Tian Shi'an.
So there’s no rush yet.
He wanted to use the Wang family's crimes to completely control the judicial power in order to take action against Tian Shi'an later.
"As ordered." Sun Muyun handed over his hands and left.
…
The appointment of Kaifu arrived on the fifth day after Lu Zhou found evidence of the Wang family's crimes.
In the early morning of that day, the imperial envoy arrived with the decree, and all the officials of Yunzhou, big and small, came to greet him.
Tian Shian stood in the crowd with a smile on his face.
He had been waiting for this day for too long.
As long as the palace is opened, the imperial officials can be used to restrict King Yun to the palace.
So these days he has been looking forward to the imperial edict arriving soon.
Today, the wait is finally here!
At this time, the messenger had already stood on the steps, unfolded the imperial edict, and read aloud:
"By God's blessing, Emperor Wu issued an edict: It's been more than half a year since King Lu Zhou of Yun came out of Yunzhou, and everything is gradually settled. Why hasn't he opened his mansion yet?"
"The vassal prince's opening of the palace is a custom made by the country. How can it be delayed? Let's choose a day to open the palace..."
Hearing this, Tian Shian lowered his head and couldn't help but raise the corners of his mouth.
title_en: Chapter 162 The appointment of the founding of the government has arrived Chapter 161 Important people
